list.noMatch: No projects match {query}. Clear the search to see every project.
list.caption: Projects
list.undated: {count, plural, one {# project has no dates and is not shown.} other {# projects have no dates and are not shown.}}
list.addDates: Add dates in each project's settings to place it on the timeline.
list.loadError: Projects could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
list.empty: No projects yet. Create the first one with its key, jurisdiction and phase.
list.emptyReadOnly: No projects are shared with you yet. The Owner or a Producer can add you to a project, and it then appears here.
list.emptyReadOnlyNamed: No projects are shared with you yet. {names} can add you to a project, and it then appears here.

create.title: New project
create.keyHelp: Two to five capital letters, unique in your organization. Record keys start with it, for example NWL-142.
create.name: Project name
create.timeZoneHelp: Times typed for this project are read in this zone.
create.jurisdictionHelp: Where the work happens. Permit and code questions need it.
create.currencyHelp: Money on the project is priced in this currency. Left on the default, the jurisdiction's country decides, then your organization's base currency.

errors.keyFormat: Use two to five capital letters for the key, for example NWL.
errors.name: Enter a project name of up to 200 characters.
errors.timeZone: Choose the time zone the project works in.
errors.dates: The last production day cannot come before the first.
errors.reason: Say why, in up to 500 characters. Every change is logged with its reason.
errors.evidenceUri: Enter a link starting with https:// or a record key such as NWL-12.
errors.scopeCode: Use capital letters, digits and hyphens for the code, for example NWL-S01.
errors.scopeName: Enter a node name of up to 200 characters.
errors.conflict: That key or code is already in use. Choose another.
errors.invalid: One of the values is not allowed. Check the fields and try again.
errors.not-found: This project is no longer available to you. Reload the page to see what you can open.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong saving this change. Try again, and contact support if it keeps happening.
errors.refused: The change was refused ({rule}). Review the project and try again.
errors.plan_limit_exceeded: Your plan's active project limit is reached. Complete or cancel a project, or change plans, to add another.
errors.plan_limit_read_only: This project is read-only because the organization is over its plan's active project limit. The banner at the top of the page says how to lift it.
errors.time_zone_unknown: That time zone is not recognized. Choose one from the list.
errors.gate_criteria_unmet: Gate {gate} cannot pass until every blocking criterion has evidence. Missing: {criteria}.
errors.gate_phase_conflict: The project moved to another phase while you were working. Reload to see its current gate.
errors.gate_already_passed: This gate has already been passed.
errors.project_canceled: A canceled project passes no gates. Reopen it first if the work resumes.
errors.transition_reason_required: Say why. Every change is logged with its reason.
errors.project_transition_not_allowed: The project cannot move to that state from where it is now.
errors.project_state_conflict: The project changed state while you were working. Reload and try again.
errors.production_transition_not_allowed: The production cannot move to that state from where it is now.
errors.production_state_conflict: The production changed state while you were working. Reload and try again.
errors.scope_root_retained: The engagement root stays while the project exists.
errors.scope_node_has_children: Remove the nodes beneath this node first.
errors.scope_node_parent_deleted: The parent node was removed. Choose another parent.
errors.scope_node_parent_project: The parent node belongs to another project.
errors.gate_evidence_reference: Evidence must name a document link or a record.
errors.gate_evidence_immutable: Evidence cannot be edited. Withdraw it and attest new evidence instead.
errors.sod_self_grant: You cannot add yourself to a project. Ask another manager to add you.
errors.project_member_immutable: Remove the member and add them again instead of changing who they are.
errors.comment: Write a comment of up to 10,000 characters.
errors.fileSize: Files can be up to 50 MB. Choose a smaller file.
errors.currency: Choose a currency from the list.
errors.project_currency_required: Choose a currency, or set your organization's base currency in settings.
errors.event_type_archived: This event type is archived. Choose another, or restore it in Settings, Templates.
errors.template_unpublished: That template has no published version. Publish one in Templates first.
errors.template_time_zone_required: Choose the project's time zone; the template does not set one.
errors.project_bump_window_bounds: Give the first and the last day of each of load-in and load-out, in order.
errors.project_bump_window_length: Load-in and load-out each last at most 60 days.
errors.copy_nothing: Choose at least one part to copy.
errors.copy_other_org: Copy between projects of the same organization.
errors.copy_same_project: Choose another project to copy from.
errors.copy_offset_unknown: Set the show dates on both projects, or give the number of days to move everything by.
errors.copy_too_large: This copy has more than 2,000 items. Copy fewer parts at a time.
errors.copy_forbidden: You cannot copy into this project. Ask someone who manages it.
errors.cross_org_reference: Something chosen belongs to another organization.
errors.gate_documents_missing: Gate {gate} needs the required documents first. Missing: {items}.
errors.gate_fields_missing: Gate {gate} needs the required details first. Missing: {items}.
errors.intakeLoadIn: Give the first and last load-in days, the last on or after the first.
errors.intakeLoadOut: Give the first and last load-out days, the last on or after the first.
errors.intakeCopyParts: Choose at least one part to copy.
errors.intakeCopyOffset: Give a whole number of days, up to 3,660 either way.

transition.reasonHelp: Logged with the change and shown in the history.

overview.title: Overview
overview.allPassed: Every gate is passed. The project rests in Close.
overview.noBlockers: Nothing blocks the next gate. Pass it from the Gates tab when the team is ready.
overview.noActivity: No activity on this project yet. Changes appear here as the team works.

scope.title: Scope
scope.removeConfirm: Remove {name} ({code})? Records filed under it keep their history.
scope.codeHelp: Unique in the project, for example {example}. Codes never change.
scope.name: Name
scope.selectHint: Select a node in the tree to rename it, add beneath it or remove it.
scope.emptyChildren: Nothing beneath this node yet. Add a standing venue or a show.
scope.readOnly: You can read the scope tree. Ask a project manager to change it.
scope.matrixLabel: Records of {key} by department and phase
scope.matrixNote: Counts records with a category and a phase. Records without either sit at no coordinate.
scope.kindHelp: Standing venues hold shows; a show can sit under the root or a standing venue.

gates.title: Gates
gates.uriHelp: A link starting with https://, or a record key such as NWL-12.
gates.rankHelp: Rank 0 is an absent claim and never satisfies a criterion.
gates.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this evidence? It stops counting toward the criterion and stays in the history.
gates.passTitleLast: Pass gate {gate} and close the project
gates.passDescription: The database checks every blocking criterion before the project moves on. Passing a gate cannot be undone.
gates.passReasonHelp: For example the go or no-go decision and who ratified it.
gates.blockedBy: {count, plural, one {# blocking criterion needs evidence} other {# blocking criteria need evidence}}
gates.noHistory: No gate has been passed yet. Gate 1 closes Scope.
gates.readOnly: You can read the gates. Ask a project manager to attest evidence or pass a gate.

settings.title: Project settings
settings.generalLead: The key, name, place and dates of the project.
settings.membersLead: People on the project and their project roles. Membership makes project data readable to them.
settings.removeConfirm: End {name}'s access to {key}? Their past work stays attributed to them.
settings.noMembers: No one is on this project yet. Add the producer and coordinators first.
settings.noCandidates: Everyone in your organization is already on this project.
settings.lifecycleLead: Project and production states. Every change needs a reason and is logged.
settings.archiveLead: Archived projects leave the project lists and stay searchable behind a filter.
settings.archiveConfirm: Archive {key}? It leaves the project lists until restored.
settings.readOnly: You can read these settings. Ask a project manager to change them.
settings.gatewayLead: Client and sponsor access to this project is managed on the Engagements tab.

offerings.title: Offerings
offerings.description: What this project offers the people it engages. Every offering is Not offered unless the organization or this project offers it, and Gateway shows its tabs only where it is offered.
offerings.orgDescription: Rules for one role type or vendor class across every project. A project's own rule wins over these; a value the organization locked wins over every rule.
offerings.rulesDescription: Offer differently to one role type or vendor class, with optional caps. The most specific rule wins over the values above.
offerings.empty: No rules yet. The offerings above apply to everyone engaged.
offerings.readOnly: Only people who can edit project settings change offerings.

errors.conflict: A rule for this offering and audience already exists. Remove it first, or choose another role type or vendor class.
errors.invalid: Check the rule: caps go only on an offered mode, from 0 to 10000, and a vendor class only with role type Vendor or every role type.
errors.crossOrg: That vendor class belongs to another organization.
errors.notFound: You can no longer change this rule. Reload the page.
errors.unexpected: The rule did not save. Try again.

collab.noComments: No comments yet. Post the first note for the project team.
collab.noAttachments: No files yet. Attach contracts, drawings or decks the team needs.
collab.noAttachmentsReadOnly: No files are attached to this project yet.

intake.noEventTypeHelp: Start without a type; nothing extra is required.

startFrom.label: Start from
startFrom.typeHelp: The template the type picks for the scale and audience you choose next.
startFrom.templateHelp: Any published project template of your organization.
startFrom.projectHelp: Copy its plan, pass categories, hotel blocks, budgets and advance forms, moved to the new dates.
startFrom.blankHelp: Only the project and its root scope node.

audienceHelp.Internal: Your own people or a client's staff attend.

intake.bumpHelp: Load-in and load-out days are saved as project days and give the bump-in and bump-out windows.

review.fromProject: None; setup is copied from the past project

eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.lead: The kinds of event you produce. Each picks the template a new project starts from by scale and audience, and the details and documents a project of the type needs by a gate.
eventTypes.loadFailed: This list could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
eventTypes.empty: No event types yet. Add one to offer it at New project.
eventTypes.noRules: No template rules; projects of this type start blank.
eventTypes.noFields: No details; intake shows only the organization's required project fields.
eventTypes.noProjectFields: Add project fields in Settings, Custom fields to ask them at intake.
eventTypes.noDocumentTypes: Add document types below to require them.
eventTypes.readOnly: Only people who manage templates change these.
eventTypes.name: Name
eventTypes.descriptionHelp: Shown on the event type's card at New project.
eventTypes.guidanceHelp: What to have ready, shown beside the type's details at intake.

documentTypes.title: Document types
documentTypes.lead: The kinds of project document you file, such as a site plan. Event types require them by a gate.
documentTypes.empty: No document types yet. Add your own or the XOS standard types.
documentTypes.name: Name
documentTypes.adopted: Standard types added; names you already had were left as they are.

setup.title: Setup
setup.summary: {requiredMet} of {requiredTotal} required and {recommendedMet} of {recommendedTotal} recommended items done
setup.complete: Everything this event type asks for is in place.

warnings.project_bump_in_after_show: Bump-in must end by the end of the first show day.
warnings.project_bump_out_before_show: Bump-out must start on or after the last show day.
warnings.project_bump_window_length: A bump window is longer than 60 days.
warnings.project_bump_window_dates: Set the first and last show days to check the bump days against them.

copy.title: Copy from another project
copy.lead: Copy the setup of a past project into this one, moved by a number of days. Shifts, people, engagements and the party's answers are never copied.
copy.offsetHelp: Filled from the two first show days. Times keep their local time.
copy.previewLead: This is what the copy writes; nothing has changed yet.

reasons.scope_code_taken: A node with this code is already on the project.
reasons.outside_copy: What it links to is not part of the copy.
reasons.dependency_needs_timeline: Copying dependencies needs permission to change the schedule.
reasons.day_taken: The project already has this day.
reasons.day_needs_timeline: Copying project days needs permission to change the schedule.
reasons.code_taken: A category with this code is already on the project; its access rows go to that one.
reasons.zone_other_venue: Its zone is at another venue.
reasons.event_cost_center_cleared: Its cost center belongs to the old event, so it was left empty.
reasons.category_missing: The project has no pass category with this code. Copy the pass categories too.
